title: Registry Revision, Provenance, and Compatible-Observation Joins, 2026
disclosure: The thirty-two-file archive contains twenty-nine official-link records, consolidated summaries, a README, and a checksum manifest.
method_note: Source revision and compatible join are not operating outcomes. Alias, field, authority, stage, operator, unit, work-breakdown, capacity, qualification, acceptance, implementation, and closure remain distinct.
